description: The file implements asynchronous functions for generating unique IDs using cryptographic randomness, including 'nanoid', 'customAlphabet', and 'random'. It also requires external modules 'crypto' and a local 'url-alphabet'.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes and resolves with the buffer.

methods.name: customAlphabet
methods.description: Creates a function to generate uniquely identifiable strings of a specified size using a custom alphabet.

methods.name: nanoid
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string of specified size using cryptographic randomness and the URL-safe alphabet.
